option.counterfactual: Although λ(k) does not give the general extremal size of suitable permutation systems, the particular choice M_d = λ(d − 1) + 1 nevertheless guarantees dim Q_d = d.
option.approach: Prove the lower bound dim Q_d ≥ d by assigning a maximal intersecting family to each vertex in a hypothetical realizer. Then seek an independent construction of d suitable permutations to prove the matching upper bound.
